examples: The medicine had an effect.
The effect was big.
Rain has an effect on plants.

more.def: A change that is caused by something.
examples: The medicine had a good effect.
Rain has a big effect on the garden.
The loud sound had an effect on the dog.
The medicine is effective.
The plan was effective.
An effective way to learn.

more.def: Doing what it should do, or giving the result that you want.
examples: The medicine was effective and my cough went away.
Soap is effective at removing germs.
The poster was an effective way to share the news.

easy.def: In a way that works well.
examples: She worked effectively.
The medicine worked effectively.
He used his time effectively.

more.def: In a way that gets the result you want.
examples: She used her time effectively and finished her homework early.
The medicine worked effectively, and I felt better in a day.
The team worked effectively together to build the fort.

easy.def: Doing a job well without wasting anything.
examples: The cook worked with efficiency.
Efficiency saves time.
Her efficiency was great.

more.def: The ability to do a job well without wasting time, energy or materials.
examples: The cook worked with great efficiency, and dinner was ready in half an hour.
A new machine improved the efficiency of the factory.
The efficiency of the new light bulb helps us save electricity.

easy.def: Working well without wasting time or things.
examples: The new oven is efficient.
He is an efficient worker.
An efficient plan saves time.

more.def: Doing a job well without wasting time, energy or materials.
examples: The new dishwasher is efficient and uses very little water.
An efficient cook can make a whole dinner in thirty minutes.
Riding the bus is an efficient way for many people to get to the city.
It takes effort to learn to read.
Thank you for your effort.
Cleaning my room took a lot of effort.

more.def: The energy and hard work you use to do something.
examples: With a lot of effort, they pushed the heavy sled up the hill.
The whole team made an effort to welcome the new player.
It took real effort to carry the canoe to the lake.
